## Summary
Provide a clear and concise description of the feature or improvement.

---

## Acceptance Criteria
List measurable conditions that define “done” for this feature.
- [ ] Criteria 1
- [ ] Criteria 2

---

## Definition of Ready (DoR)
- [ ] User story is clearly written and understandable by all team members.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are defined and testable.
- [ ] Dependencies are identified and resolved or scheduled.
- [ ] Designs, mockups, or specifications are attached (if applicable).
- [ ] Business value and priority are clear.
- [ ] Estimate (story points) provided by the team.
- [ ] Non-functional requirements (security, performance, etc.) are considered.
- [ ] Stakeholder or PO has reviewed and approved it for development.

---

## Implementation Notes
Status & comments about implementation.

---

## Definition of Done (DoD)
- [ ] Code implemented and reviewed
- [ ] Unit/integration tests added
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, Wiki, etc.)
- [ ] Merged to `main`/`develop`
- [ ] Deployed to staging
- [ ] Stakeholder acceptance
